home.seoDescription: Loopa Technology: applied AI for commercial profitability in your company’s complementary segments. Multi-agent platform, data cleansing, predictive analytics and political image.
home.heroSubtitle: We help your company’s complementary segments —the ones with fixed commercial targets that don’t get full attention or resources— hit their goals, on the budget they actually need.
home.problemStatText: Airline case: a segment that was neither leisure nor corporate generated more than US$20M in additional annual revenue. Replicating moves like that is a major challenge for any company.

problemPoints.title: Root cause: the core comes first
problemPoints.text: Overlooked opportunities leave millions of dollars on the table every year.

problemPoints.title: Peak efficiency has a cost
problemPoints.text: When the whole commercial team targets the main business, complementary lines get no attention: that is opportunity cost.

home.platformText: LOOPA connects existing, overlooked markets with your available internal capacity, while your company keeps its attention on its main operation.

agents.title: Predictive Agent
agents.text: Spots overstock or idle capacity months in advance. Connects to your ERP.

agents.title: Market Agent
agents.text: One click to optimize price, distribution and promotion, with visual content and a video script, backed by big data for social listening.

agents.title: Proximity Agent
agents.text: Evaluates which companies in our portfolio can bring each other the most value and recommends the partnership.

home.platformOneClick: Connect existing market demand with your idle capacity in one click.
home.edgeHeading: LOOPA stands out where generic AI and MCPs fail complementary business lines.

edges.title: Data flywheel
edges.text: Every user interaction refines the ML and AI models. The platform improves with use.

edges.title: Beyond LLMs and agents
edges.text: Telecom infrastructure and big data with thousands of specialized data points, not just token or GPU spend.

edges.title: Human corporate community
edges.text: Recommendations combine data with access to a community of companies that can do business with each other.

home.icpHeading: Built for people with targets to hit.
icp: Heads of complementary products or markets: accessories, spare parts, armoring, overgrips, student segment.
home.partnersText: We work with ERPs and CRMs with strong market penetration, such as Odoo and Mercately, and run a partner program for marketing agencies and well-connected people who want to refer us.

validation.title: Government
validation.text: $1.1M social listening tender covering 500 radio, TV and digital information sources.

validation.title: International expansion
validation.text: Recurring client in the United Kingdom.

home.ecosystemText: We are room organizers in a community backed by Big Tech (Google DeepMind, Apple, Amazon), LatamGPT and Accel Ventures, and part of a LATAM talent network with mentoring and access to PhDs.
home.finalCtaText: Tell us which business line needs to hit its target and we’ll show you how we make it profitable.

about.seoDescription: Meet the Loopa Technology team: a data and AI consultancy focused on governance, data sovereignty and DAMA-DMBOK standards across LatAm.
about.heading: Data Engineers Leading the Next Analytics Wave
about.subheading: We combine global governance methodologies with cutting-edge technology to empower Latin America's most dynamic enterprises.
about.missionText: Democratize access to and the intelligent exploitation of data at scale across Latin America, providing analytics architectures and AI models that guarantee data sovereignty, meet legal privacy requirements and generate real profitability.
about.visionText: To become, by 2029, the reference technical consultancy for analytics processing and secure AI deployment in Latin America, connecting robust data infrastructure with the business needs of finance, e-commerce and telecommunications.
about.pillarsHeading: The pillars behind every line of code
about.pillarsSubheading: We operate under strict engineering standards to avoid bad practices and guarantee our clients' data quality end to end.
about.pillar1Text: The security of your information is non-negotiable. We deploy AI and storage in your own cloud, so you always keep full control.
about.pillar2Text: We don't invent theoretical methodologies to stretch timelines. We focus on fast sprints with functional deliverables from month one.
about.pillar3Text: All of our engineering follows the most demanding global frameworks for quality, data lineage and architectural traceability.
about.teamSubheading: Our team combines international-level backgrounds in data science, advanced NLP and corporate IT governance.
about.quoteText: "We don't sell PDF reports that end up archived. We build high-engineering software and real governance so data predictably solves our region's daily business challenges."
